text:
alyssa: quick follow-up from the PM postmortem for the api-cache-eviction incident — need to assign owners for the action items and lock timelines. postmortem link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/POSTM-1234

Action items (short):
- POSTM-1234: TTL audit & unify cache policy across services — due 2026-04-02 (needs owner)
- POSTM-1236: retry/backoff tuning for inference-proxy — due 2026-04-09 (needs owner)
- POSTM-1238: hot-key detection alert + dashboard — due 2026-04-05 (needs owner)
- POSTM-1240: ops runbook + canary rollout playbook — due 2026-04-07 (needs owner)

Can people claim owners so I can update RACI + Jira statuses?

omar: I can take POSTM-1234 (TTL audit). will scope by EOD tomorrow and propose checklist. @priya can you review the query shapes?

priya: ack. I can review. prefer shifting TTL audit deadline to Tue (2026-04-06) because of infra window next week, is that ok?

alyssa: noted. preference is to keep remediation fast but okay if you need the window — mark tentative and we'll lock after scoping.

dan: I'll pick up POSTM-1236 (retry/backoff tuning). plan: add circuit-breaker config + perf tests. aiming to open PR by 2026-04-08.

maya: happy to be backup for POSTM-1234 + POSTM-1236. also volunteer to own POSTM-1238 (alerts/dashboard) if no objections.

incident-bot: Created ticket POSTM-1238 and added @maya as assignee (automated).

omar: thanks. I'll add a short doc for service-level cache defaults and a migration checklist. putting notes in POSTM-1234.

sam: quick heads-up — there's an older spike (SPK-1712) that did cache-key sampling. I'll cross-link and close duplicates if it's the same scope.

alyssa: RACI proposal for the runbook & rollout: R=dan (implementation), A=@alyssa (approval), C=@priya (query impact), I=@omar/@maya (ops/backup). Does that look right?

dan: that works for me. I'll draft the canary steps and include rollback triggers (error rate + latency delta). code snippet for canary checks:```
if latency_delta > 15% or error_rate > 0.5%: rollback
```

priya: added a comment on POSTM-1236 to call out high-p99 paths — will validate after dan's perf tests.

alyssa: perfect. I'll create a single remediation tracker ticket and add all POSTM items as sub-tasks so we have one owner-of-record. action: everyone update their Jira ticket statuses by COB Friday (2026-03-27). :thumbsup:

omar: will update POSTM-1234 today.

maya: starting POSTM-1238 dashboard draft tomorrow.

priya: noted, will review queries by Tue.

alyssa: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for now, reopening if owners need to reassign. :white_check_mark:
